2026 Repco Bathurst 1000 track schedule revealed

Supercars
5d
52 drivers are set to battle it out for the Peter Brock Trophy
5 mins by Supercars.com
Bathurst
Repco Bathurst 1000
Endurance
...
Advertisement

  • Track schedule released for 2026 Repco Bathurst 1000, October 8-11

  • 2026 Great Race to begin at 11:30am AEDT on Sunday, October 12

  • On-track action begins at Mount Panorama on Thursday October 8

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 7:21
Instaread

The full track schedule for the 2026 Repco Bathurst 1000 has been unveiled, just over a month out from The Great Race.

The 66th running of the endurance classic, the 2026 event will see 52 drivers across 26 cars tackle the iconic Mount Panorama to be crowned the latest Kings of the Mountain.

The 2026 event will commemorate the 20th anniversary of the passing of the original King of the Mountain, Peter Brock, with a collection of the nine-time winner's Bathurst cars to be on display throughout the course of the event.

An audiovisual experience celebrating Brock's career will be set up in Bathurst town centre from Monday, October 5, and will remain in place through race week.

The Repco Fan Fast will also return on Tuesday, October 6, as will the popular Track to Town activation on Wednesday, October 7, that will also feature the Live Finals of the 2026 PIRTEK Pit Stop Challenge.

Campers also have the option to remain at their campsites until 10:00am on the Tuesday following race day.

The 2026 edition of the Bathurst 1000 will also have a slightly earlier start time, with the 1000km race to commence at 11:30am AEST, 15 minutes earlier than last year's race.

Supercars will be in action across all four days of the event from October 8-11, with six practice sessions, and the traditional Friday Boost Mobile Qualifying session building up to the legendary Saturday afternoon Top Ten Shootout.

A 20-minute Warm Up session on Sunday morning will be the precursor to Race 30 of the 2026 season, which will also see the Ryco Enduro Cup winners crowned, and the last berths in the Repco Supercars Finals Series claimed.

Supercars will be supported by a bumper support category line-up, with the DUNLOP Super2 Series, Porsche Equity One Carrera Cup Australia, Toyota Gazoo Racing Australia GR Cup, Tyrepower V8 SuperUte Series, and Touring Car Masters all on the undercard.

Live coverage of the Repco Bathurst 1000 can be found live on screens of the Seven Network, 7plus, Kayo, and Foxtel.

Tickets and corporate hospitality options for the 2026 Great Race can be found via Supercars.com and Ticketek.

For the complete track schedule and additional event information, please visit Supercars.com.

The Repco Bathurst 1000 is supported proudly by the NSW Government through its tourism and major events agency, Destination NSW.
